wc:minerva-checkbox.summary: Checkbox with label, helper text and indeterminate state.
wc:minerva-checkbox.description: A checkbox with label, helper text and indeterminate state (`<Checkbox>` of React), rendering a native `<input type="checkbox">` in its shadow root (Space toggles it; Enter does nothing, as natively). Form-associated: when checked, submits `value` (default `"on"`) under `name`; `required` makes it invalid until checked (`valueMissing`, with the localized "check this box" message); supports `form.reset()` (restores the `checked` attribute), `<fieldset disabled>` and state restoration. `indeterminate` stays applied until it is changed (as in React), also after the user toggles the box.

properties.description: Initial checked state, restored by `form.reset()` (the `checked` attribute). Changing it also changes `checked` until the user toggles

properties.description: Shows the indeterminate (partially checked) state (aria-checked="mixed")

properties.description: Value submitted with the form when checked

properties.name: readOnly

properties.description: Name submitted with the form data

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables the control (not focusable, not submitted, not validated)

properties.name: required
properties.description: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Checked state (property; the `checked` attribute sets `defaultChecked`)

properties.name: form

properties.name: labels
properties.description: `<label>` elements associated with the element

properties.description: Validity state (same as `<input>.validity`)

custom-style.title: Custom style
custom-style.description: Recolor the box with the --checkbox-checked-color, --checkbox-checkmark-color, --checkbox-box-color and --checkbox-border-color CSS custom properties (on className or an ancestor), or show a custom icon when checked.

error.title: Error state

colors-and-form-control.title: Colors and FormControl
colors-and-form-control.description: color sets the semantic checked color (primary, success, info, warning or danger); children can be used as the label. Inside a FormControl the checkbox picks up the id, description, invalid, required and disabled state.

CheckboxProps.indeterminate: Shows the indeterminate (partially checked) state. Controlled: it stays applied until this prop changes, also after the user clicks
CheckboxProps.name: Name of the input, used in forms
CheckboxProps.onChange: Called with the new checked state and the change event
CheckboxProps.label: Label text
CheckboxProps.aria-label: Accessible label, required when there is no visible label
CheckboxProps.errorIcon: Icon shown before the helper text in the error state
CheckboxProps.helperText: Helper or error text shown below the checkbox (linked with aria-describedby)
CheckboxProps.labelPlacement: Position of the label relative to the box
CheckboxProps.children: Label content (alternative to label; used when label is not set)
CheckboxProps.color: Semantic color of the checked / indeterminate box. For a custom look, set the --checkbox-checked-color, --checkbox-checkmark-color, --checkbox-box-color and --checkbox-border-color CSS custom properties on className or an ancestor
CheckboxProps.id: id of the input (defaults to the enclosing FormControl's id)
CheckboxProps.value: Value submitted with the form when checked
CheckboxProps.aria-describedby: Extra ids of elements describing the checkbox (aria-describedby)
CheckboxProps.aria-labelledby: id(s) of the element(s) labelling the checkbox
CheckboxProps.style: Inline styles of the label element

methods.click: Clicks the inner control (toggles it unless disabled or read-only).
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
